sources.snippet: This page documents the quantization configurations and architectural specificities for the broader set of supported model families in the APEX project. These configurations address diverse architectures, including hybrid Attention+SSM+MoE models (Darwin), architectures with short-convolution SSM layers (Step37), and MLA-style attention models (MiniMax).
